sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Instrument icons from the userscript "MusicBrainz: Instrument Icons Everywhere" (by Lotheric) are now also kept, counted and filterable when that script is set to show them AFTER the instrument name (its new 2026-10-12.2140 option): the 📊 "Instrument info - Icon" section shows "🎻 with instrument icon" again, "» instrument:" entries carry their icon, a copied icon stays on the side the script put it, and an icon that loads after the table is built reaches the underlying rows on multi-table pages too.
